description: Read the published overview of a GoVisit destination. Use it to identify the destination, understand its geographic context, and get an introduction before exploring its places or activities. Returns the overview with its canonical page and freshness.

pagePath.description: Canonical GoVisit page path supplying this tool's published context; no origin, query or fragment.

name: get_destination_overview

outputSchema.description: Successful read of the sanitized published page snapshot. Unsupported sections reject the invocation.

description.description: Published long destination description in the page language; empty when absent.

metaDescription.description: Published search and page meta description in the page language; null when absent.

overview.description: Legacy published overview field in the page language; null when absent.

items.description: Published JSON value; optional field shapes depend on the page projection.
